purpose: Shared cases for the spatial safety rule (AGENTS.md, task E13). Hazard position/distance/step count/clearance and all step counts come only from sensor code; model text containing them is not spoken. Model directions and distances for everyday objects are allowed when worded as estimates; sensor measurements are spoken confidently by code. server/src/spatial-guard.mjs and BlindCore SpatialClaimGuard must agree on every case.
